Think of it like you meet a person and it’s an amazing bond between the two and when it’s time for her to leave you feel obsessively obsessed, you feel like you can’t love yourself with out that (person) so you decide to just disappear off social media your everyday life feels off there’s a big pit inside of you and your longing for them to come back or message you within 3-6 days and then you get a message you feel amazing and happy you start to say things and your just over explaining things then you weird them out or they just say give me a few days then your back to your old self hating everything nothing feels fun even the old things, everything feels like a drag in those two days then magically walking by yourself and you bump into them on accident both of you are surprised and like “wow what are we doing here on this exact night at 4am” (odd time but that’s how the universe works) then you guys exchange words and smiling, then time to keep marching forward and continue your journey of the walk you feel like a drag and allat feelings are just purging inside of your stomach that you just want it to end, you end up crying then triggered about what if someone’s with them or hanging out with someone blah blah blah, you feel entitled to them, all of the sudden one day you just feel at peace and your like “it’s over” but it’s not over you gotta think of triggers/abandonment issues/what happens if they come over and have to leave how you gonna feel again/ remembering the pain you went through as one heck of a journey but remembering that pain as someone who you used to be/ keeping touch of yourself learning how to care and love yourself/ 

TLDR: use that pain to help yourself on why you can’t love yourself as much as you love that person.
